versions.name: Generous Gifts
versions.text: Whenever you take DMG, gain counters equal to DMG taken. When this reaches 11+, spend them to summon a 3/3 Gift.

versions.name: Generous Gifts
versions.text: Whenever you take DMG during the enemy turn, gain counters equal to DMG taken. When this reaches 10+ counters, summon a 3/3 gift.

versions.name: Generous Gifts
versions.text: Whenever you take DMG during the enemy turn, gain counters equal to DMG taken. At 10 counters, earn 2 G.

versions.name: Generous Gifts
versions.text: Whenever you take DMG during the enemy turn, gain counters equal to DMG taken. At 12 counters, earn 2 G.

versions.name: Generous Gifts
versions.text: Whenever you play a monster costing 3+ G, gain a counter. Every 5 counters, summon a Gift and give it +1/+1 for every 5 counters this has.
